cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: A compensation assignment remains identifiable per worker and concurrent Employment or Position context independently of band, payroll and payment.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CA-01.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: A change to authorized terms or effective interval appends a successor assignment version and never overwrites history.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CA-02.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: An assignment owns only base, allowance, differential and target-variable components; reusable incentive eligibility may require a separate plan boundary.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CA-03.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: Every component pins currency, basis, period, frequency, FTE or working-time normalization, effective interval and source authority.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CA-04.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: An assignment references Employment and/or Position, may cite at most one band per effective interval, and may cite an authorizing WM-REC-010 decision.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CA-05.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: Concurrent employments or positions have distinct assignment identities.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CA-06.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: A WM-REC-010 decision may authorize, reject or amend proposed terms; only a successor assignment carries authorized terms.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CA-07.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: An unapplied recommendation remains on the decision and does not alter an assignment.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CA-08.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: Assignment effective time, decision time, payroll period, payment value date and remittance due date are distinct.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CA-09.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: A mid-period change requires versioned terms and explicit proration inputs.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CA-10.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: An assignment authorizes possible remuneration and never asserts earned pay, payslip issuance, payment or settlement.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CA-11.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: Original-currency terms are preserved; conversions are explicit derived observations.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CA-12.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: Absence of assignment data is unknown, never zero.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CA-13.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: Decision date, communication date, effective time, earning interval, payroll period, payment value date, remittance due date, observation time and knowledge time are distinct axes.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CA-14.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: A correction of erroneous recorded knowledge and a retroactive amendment of business effect are distinct append-only events and never rewrite the original assertion.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CA-15.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: FTE and working-time normalization are referenced from WM-ORG-004 capacity or WM-ORG-005 working-time patterns and are not mastered by the assignment.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CA-16.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: Each FX conversion pins source, rate type, quotation direction, determination time and rounding; derived inverse rates and silent conversion are prohibited.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CA-17.

cases.input: An implementation contradicts this rule: In-kind terms and equity grant references are recorded as external references; reusable incentive eligibility and equity-plan administration remain outside this candidate.
cases.expect: The contradiction is rejected under EM-PEO-09.CA-18.
